# Thunderbird Mail Interface Description

## System and Window Management

- **Operating System**: Linux (based on desktop environment and application icons)
- **Desktop Environment**: GNOME (indicated by "Activities" button and dock layout)
- **Window Title**: "Write: (no subject) - Thunderbird"
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in top-right corner
- **Window State**: The "Write" email composition window is active and in the foreground
- **System Tray**: Located at the top-right of the screen, showing time ("Oct 23 00:14"), notification bell, and system icons (network, sound, etc.)

## Application Header and Navigation

- **Application Name**: "Thunderbird Mail" displayed in the top-left corner
- **Main Window Title**: "Important - Local Folders - Mozilla Thunderbird"
- **Search Bar**: Located in the top-right of the main window, with a magnifying glass icon
- **Menu Bar**: Standard application menu items: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Options, Tools, Help
- **Quick Filter**: Located near the top of the main window, with a filter icon

## Left Sidebar (Application Dock)

- **Activities Button**: Located at the top-left of the dock
- **Application Icons** (from top to bottom):
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird Mail (active)
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (Question Mark)
  - Trash

## Email Composition Window

### Header Section

- **Window Title**: "Write: (no subject) - Thunderbird"
- **Menu Bar**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Options, Tools, Help
- **Toolbar**:
  - Send button (with arrow icon)
  - Encrypt button (with lock icon)
  - Spelling dropdown
  - Save dropdown
  - Contacts button
  - Attach button (with paperclip icon) and dropdown

### Email Fields

- **From Field**:
  - Pre-filled with "Mathias Gadenzi <mathias.gadenzi@gmail.com>"
  - Dropdown arrow next to the email address for selection
- **To Field**:
  - Empty text input field with orange border, indicating it is active and ready for input
- **Cc Field**:
  - Label "Cc" with a dropdown arrow
- **Bcc Field**:
  - Label "Bcc" with a dropdown arrow
- **Subject Field**:
  - Empty text input field

### Formatting Toolbar

- **Paragraph Dropdown**: For paragraph formatting options
- **Variable Width Dropdown**: For text width settings
- **Text Formatting Buttons**:
  - Left Align
  - Center Align
  - Right Align
  - Bold (B)
  - Italic (I)
  - Underline (U)
  - Strikethrough
  - Font Color
  - Background Color
  - List (Unordered and Ordered)
  - Indent/Outdent
  - Quote
  - Insert Link
  - Insert Image
  - Insert Emoji (smiley face icon)

## Main Email Body

- **Text Area**: Large white area for composing the email body
- **Status Bar**: Located at the bottom of the composition window
  - "Done" text with a small icon to its left

## Main Thunderbird Window (Background)

### Welcome Page

- **Header**: "Welcome to FREEDOM"
- **Main Text**: "Thunderbird is a gift from thousands of people like you. We hope you'll enjoy the productivity, privacy, and freedom they make possible and we invite you to become part of that gift to others."
- **Donate Button**: Blue button with a heart icon and text "Donate"
- **Subtext**: "Help keep Thunderbird alive!"

### Feature Boxes

#### Free and Open Source

- **Title**: "Free and Open Source"
- **Subtitle**: "Thunderbird is now yours forever."
- **Description**: "Thunderbird is developed openly and distributed freely. Our software license protects your right to use, modify, and share Thunderbird. Our mission is to protect your privacy and freedom."
- **Button**: "Get Help" with a hand icon

#### Powered by Community

- **Title**: "Powered by Community"
- **Subtitle**: "You can become part of our story."
- **Description**: "Anyone can contribute to Thunderbird. By donating, translating, answering questions, suggesting features, reporting bugs, and more, you make Thunderbird better for yourself and the world."
- **Button**: "Participate" with a pencil icon

### Footer

- **Call to Action**: "Want new features sooner? Learn about Thunderbird Release." with a hyperlink to "Thunder
